items.title: BSEC introduces single-window IPO review system
items.description: The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission (BSEC) has approved a single-window initial public offering (IPO) review system to make the application process more efficient, integrated and time-saving.

items.title: BB seeks explanation from bKash over 7,000 fake accounts
items.description: Bangladesh Bank has sought an explanation from bKash, the country’s leading mobile financial service (MFS) provider, over the detection of more than 7,000 suspected fake accounts on its platform.

items.title: 64.5% of adults now financially included: survey
items.description: Bangladesh has made notable strides in expanding its formal financial ecosystem, with the National Financial Inclusion Survey 2025 revealing that 64.5 percent of the adult population is now formally financially included.

items.title: BASIC Bank gets HQ building after 13-year legal battle
items.description: After more than a decade of legal battles, BASIC Bank PLC yesterday took possession of a 12-storey building in Motijheel that it had bought for its head office but never received from the developer.

items.title: Brazil widens lead as Bangladesh’s top cotton supplier
items.description: Brazil has consolidated its position as Bangladesh’s leading raw cotton supplier in marketing year (MY) 2025-26, expanding its market share.

items.title: Partnerships should create opportunities, not dependencies
items.description: The world’s economic map is being reshaped by geopolitical competition, shifting supply chains and the growing use of trade as an instrument of influence.

items.title: NRBC Bank to invest Tk 100cr in securities subsidiary
items.description: NRBC Bank will invest Tk 100 crore in its subsidiary, NRBC Bank Securities Limited, within the next 30 days.
